libs.note: BH-9672. Ends the PLAN_STALE loop on a resumed ticket. The pre-plan adopt step runs the plan thread gate's classifier before it adopts (PREPLAN_STALE, the plan stage runs). A refused pre-plan is retired at its source, the coordination DB row included (POST /api/preplans/retire). A refusal on a resumed branch whose comment ids match an earlier PLAN_STALE RESULT of the ticket writes one ALERTS line and plans fresh with the branch commits in the prompt; EXECUTE then runs under the new plan. Resolved by psr_knob with lib_env_apply plan-stale-replan.

knobs.zero_means: off: the adopt step does not read the thread, and the plan thread gate judges the adopted plan as before
knobs.note: 1 = a pre-plan older than an uncited comment by a person or our App is PREPLAN_STALE at adopt and its DB row is retired.

knobs.zero_means: off: a repeat refusal on a resumed branch ends PLAN_STALE as the first one does
knobs.note: 1 = a refusal on a resumed branch with the same comment ids as an earlier PLAN_STALE of the ticket writes one ALERTS line and plans fresh in the same run.
How many of the newest kind=build jobs rows (and local build dirs) of the ticket the repeat check reads. The measured loops were 2-4 builds long.
The most branch commits (and diffstat lines) the branch note puts in the plan prompt and the replan-on-branch marker. It bounds the prompt.
